story.title: SQLite Critical CVEs or LLM Slop?

draft:
I've been following the recent SQLite vulnerabilities and I'm struck by the role of Large Language Models in identifying them. 
Research suggests these models can introduce false positives, complicating the patching process. 
I'm left wondering if LLMs are more help or hindrance in vulnerability detection.
Can we trust LLM-driven vulnerability reports?
#SQLite #LLM #VulnerabilityDetection
